title: make the base test command green
body: assoc_in must replace a nested value that is not an array

The test suite is red on this base: tests/GetInTest.php case testAssocIn #4 fails. assoc_in(["foo" => null], ["foo", "bar"], "new value") does not build the missing level when the value on the path is null or a scalar.
Outcome: assoc_in replaces a non-array value on the path with an array and sets the new value; the whole existing test file passes. Fix src/get_in.php; do not edit the existing tests.
